title: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: They seek out living trees to glean age-old secrets from sap and wood.
"These alleys are not safe. Come, I can guide you back to the market square."
Zendikar's elves have developed innovative methods to mitigate the effects of the Roil.
"From a tiny sprout, the greatest trees grow and flourish. May the seeds of your mind be equally fruitful."
Desmera blinded her seers so that her beauty would be the last image burned in their memories. The act only deepened their insight.
Nature's arms encircle all who are willing to draw close.
"Zendikar will not surrender, and neither can we."
Once, Nissa selected worthy fighters to defend the Joraga. Now, she gathers forces to defend all of Zendikar.
"Roam as you will, your roots remain in the strong earth of your Rising."
"The world was not hostile to us—we were beneath its notice, and presented no danger." —*The Invokers' Tales*
"A good lagac will carry you through thick and thin. A bad one . . . well, it's a tasty dinner." —Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter
Eldrazi are not the leopard's preferred prey, but they are better than no prey at all.
"The horizon is the perpetual ideal, the constant promise of hope." —Nissa Revane
Their arrows are tipped with basilisk eyes and fletched with cockatrice feathers.
"The most elegant solutions are found in nature. You just have to know where to look."
Through the waves of Eldrazi attacks, the Murasan jungles seemed to regrow as soon as they were destroyed.
It carries the hopes of Zendikar's embattled wilds on its mighty boughs.
"I will secure my revenge on Zendikar one soul at a time." —Ob Nixilis
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier." —Ob Nixilis
Fast and lethal, with a penchant for the weak and infirm.
"Avoid anything that scuttles, scrabbles, or shambles." —Opar, veteran guide
The mouth must be pried open before rigor mortis sets in. Otherwise the returning soul can find no ingress.
"Later we will mourn those we have lost. First we must end their suffering." —Drana, Kalastria bloodchief
"Take what solace you can in the knowledge that you will not be here to witness Zendikar's demise." —Ob Nixilis
Rats and vultures devour. It desecrates.
"Brave scar or unfortunate tale? It all depends on your pain threshold."
"One little word was all it took. The world shook as I said it. The doom of Zendikar was here at last." —Ob Nixilis
The imp, unaware of its own odor, paused to catch its breath . . . and promptly died.
Its sting hurts, but death is strangely painless.
Few among the living understand just how much of their world is shaped by the ruins of the dead.
"A little dark magic won't stop me. The worse the curse, the better the prize." —Radavi, Joraga relic hunter, last words
The promise of anguish is payment enough for services rendered.
Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.
As the bridge snapped, Berko was sure he heard the swamp laughing at him.
"I have schemed too long to be supplanted by dead gods. If I cannot have this world, no one can."
Some will sacrifice everything for but a taste of power.
Confront it at your own peril, for it will confront you for its own amusement.
Take away a few things, and a rebellion may ensue. Take away everything, and the oppression will be accepted as fate.
Setting foot in their muck is an open invitation.
Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.
Agreements with demons seldom end at the grave.
